question: Which identity provider for <app>: keep <current>, move to Zitadel, or Keycloak?
context: Small team, self-hosted on Kubernetes, needs OIDC for web and machine-to-machine tokens; SPIFFE for workloads already.

criteria.measure: OIDC for users plus client-credentials or token exchange for services
components to run, upgrade cadence, backup and restore story
advisories in the last 24 months and time to fix
licence and hosting cost at our size

options.prompt: Keep <current>: what it lacks against the criteria.
